/* isry.regns.casemng.casereg.mapper.saveData - Lee.Myeong.Sang */ MERGE INTO ACA150 /* 위기스크리닝척도 */ USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND CRISIS_SCRENN_TRGT_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_TRGT_SE_CD} AND CRISIS_SCRENN_RELM_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_RELM_SE_CD}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE}, /* 위기스크리닝평가점수 */ CRISIS_SCRENN_RESULT_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_SCRENN_RESULT_SE_CD}, /* 위기스크리닝결과구분코드 */
LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, /* 사례관리번호 */ CASE_MNG_ODRNO, /* 사례관리차수 */
CRISIS_SCRENN_TRGT_SE_CD, /* 위기스크리닝대상구분코드 */ CRISIS_SCRENN_RELM_SE_CD, /* 위기스크리닝영역구분코드 */ CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE, /* 위기스크리닝평가점수 */ CRISIS_SCRENN_RESULT_SE_CD, /* 위기스크리닝결과구분코드 */
FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO},
#{CRISIS_SCRENN_TRGT_SE_CD}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_RELM_SE_CD}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_EVL_SCORE}, #{CRISIS_SCRENN_RESULT_SE_CD},
#{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )

/* isry.regns.casemng.casereg.mapper.saveEfectnData - Lee.Myeong.Sang */ MERGE INTO ACA180 /* 청소년안전망효과성평가 */ USING DUAL ON (CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD = #{CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD} AND EFECTN_RELM_SE_CD = #{EFECTN_RELM_SE_CD}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET EFECTN_EVL_SCORE = #{EFECTN_EVL_SCORE}, /* 효과성평가점수 */ LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CASE_MNG_NO, /* 사례관리번호 */ CASE_MNG_ODRNO, /* 사례관리차수 */
CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD, /* 사례진행상태구분코드 */ EFECTN_RELM_SE_CD, /* 효과성영역구분코드 */ EFECTN_EVL_SCORE, /* 효과성평가점수 */
FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{CASE_MNG_NO}, #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO},
#{CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD}, #{EFECTN_RELM_SE_CD}, #{EFECTN_EVL_SCORE},
#{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
